# Where the port's output differs from the C++ oracle's golden sequences
# (golden_*.txt, which stay the oracle's): numbers below 1 written in
# scientific notation (F-E on), which upstream cuts short, a digit for every
# decade below 1, down to "0.e-39" (see `number_to_string` in
# crates/ratpack/src/ratpak/conv.rs; the port keeps all the digits of the
# precision).
#
# One line for each such number in a sequence:
#
#   <suite> <index> TAB <upstream's text> TAB <ours>
#
# `oracle_golden.rs` replays a listed sequence, writes each of our texts
# back as upstream's and requires the rest to match the oracle exactly. It
# fails if a sequence differs that isn't listed, if a listed number isn't
# met, or if a listed sequence matches the oracle as it is.
#
# 83 numbers in 46 of the 3,500 sequences.
